description: Na₂LaTi(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.97 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-3.02 Å. La is bonded to six O atoms to form LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.37 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.38 Å. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-35°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.60 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-41°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.63 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-46°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.64 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one La, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one La, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one P atom.
